brief: The 5-step sleep ritual that fixed my insomnia.

slots.headline: Finally Beat Your Insomnia?
slots.subtitle: The 5-step wind-down routine that actually fixed my broken sleep.

slots.title: It Starts With Consistency
slots.body: I tried everything from pills to white noise. Nothing stuck until I built a sequence my nervous system could predict. Same order. Same cues. Same result.

slots.title: Dim The Lights Early
slots.body: Start lowering lights exactly one hour before bed. Bright bulbs trick your brain into thinking it is still midday. I use lamps with warm bulbs only.

slots.title: Cut All Screens By Nine
slots.body: Blue light murders melatonin. I charge my phone outside the bedroom at 8:45 PM. No exceptions. The first two nights felt weird; by night three, I slept deeper.

slots.title: Brew A Nervine Tonic
slots.body: Magnesium and chamomile changed the game. I make the same cup every night while reading one chapter. The taste alone now signals my body to unwind.

slots.title: Write Tomorrow's Worries Down
slots.body: Brain dump every task and worry onto paper. If my body feels tense, I add gentle hip stretches. Clearing physical and mental clutter is non-negotiable now.

slots.title: Keep Bedroom Cold And Dark
slots.body: I run a fan for white noise and drop the temp to 65°F. Darkness, cool air, and silence tell your hypothalamus it is safe to shut down. I am out in ten minutes.

slots.headline: Build Your Own Ritual
slots.body: Pick one step. Do it for seven nights. Your brain will thank you.
